services.name: Scenic Pontoon Cruises
services.desc: Marsh Creek Boat Rental offers a Scenic Pontoon Cruise of Marsh Creek! Climb aboard the Miss Milford and learn about the history of the park and surrounding area, and see much of the abundant wildlife that resides in the park. Cruises last one hour long, so sit back and relax! The pontoon boat holds up to 18 people and the cost is $20.00 per adult and $15.00 per child (15 and younger). Cruises run through the summer every Saturday, Sunday and on major holidays at 10AM, 12PM, 4PM and 6PM. Groups of 6 or more passengers can book a private cruise at any day and any time between the hours of 10AM and 6PM. services.name: Paddleboard Yoga
services.desc: Our 60 minute Paddleboard Yoga classes encompass yoga and Pilates, all while balancing on a paddleboard. Whether you are a beginner or expert at paddleboarding or yoga/Pilates, all are welcome to our classes. The cost of the class is $35 which includes a life jacket, paddle and paddleboard. Please arrive 10-15 minutes prior to the start of class to leave time for parking, check-in and paddle sizing. If the class times do not work for your group, private classes may be scheduled anytime during the week and weekend mornings. Group size must be a minimum of 6 people.
